_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE weights. Keys must match feature names in features.json meta.feature_definitions. Weights are normalized by their sum inside the engine, so only ratios matter. Any weight may be set to 0 to disable a feature.

_rationale.title_overlap: highest weight: title is the densest deliberate signal of topical relevance
_rationale.abstract_overlap: second: abstracts confirm relevance but are noisier lexically
_rationale.year_in_scope: small hard constraint: out-of-scope years should hurt but not dominate
_rationale.venue_tier: moderate: heuristic venue proxy (heuristic:true), deliberately not dominant
_rationale.recency_norm: moderate: newer work preferred within scope
_rationale.semantic_score: OPTIONAL: filled only when a judgments file (one batched model call) supplies per-record semantic relevance; absent -> feature skipped
